text:
alex: Following up on the offload contract RFC. Proposal: explicit runtime <-> allocator contract with epoch-based reservations to avoid reserve/evict races.
maria: quick clarifying q: STAGED = copied to host staging buffer but still logically resident for fast reads?
alex: yes. STAGED is a fast-path host copy and still treated as resident by runtime; EVICTED means re-populate needed.
jyoti: we need per-tenant prefetch priority so allocator won't waste bandwidth on low-priority models.
sam: API idea: `reserve(handle, flags)` (returns epoch), `unreserve(handle, epoch)`, `hint_prefetch(handle, priority)`, `hint_evict(handle, reason)`, plus `batch_hint_prefetch([handles])`.
eden: eden: how do we stop races where reserve and evict both copy the same slab?
alex: allocator owns physical movement. Runtime expresses intent via hints/reserve. Allocator serializes copies and returns epoch on success. If epoch changed, reserve fails. Add `try_steal_reservation(handle)` for emergency preempt.
jyoti: telemetry: counters for transition counts, histogram for `evict_time` and `prefetch_time`, and `reserve_rejections`.
maria: add hysteresis to avoid thrash: only allow re-staging after `min_restage_ms` or if `access_count` > threshold.
sam: small-allocation case: runtime should work at allocation granularity; allocator internally coalesces tiny allocations into slabs/pages to avoid explosion.
ajx: multi-range tensors: runtime manages logical slices and issues per-slice `reserve`/`prefetch`; allocator supports efficient `batch_hint_prefetch` to reduce round-trips.
edan: fairness: allocator enforces `pin_budget` per-tenant; `reserve()` non-blocking by default with `reserve_wait(timeout_ms)` helper.
maria: security: allocator must validate tenant_id and support `scrub_on_evict` per-tenant.
runtime-bot: canary deploy: offload-contract-v1 passed canary (2/3 hosts), no perf regression detected.
alex: action items: 1) alex update RFC with API sketch + epoch semantics; 2) jyoti list telemetry metrics; 3) sam design pin_budget + canary plan; 4) eden add tests for reserve/evict races. If no objections I'll flip RFC to follow-up tomorrow. :+1:
